biggest_catch: Pay is per audio minute ($0.80–$1.10), never hourly — effective hourly earnings depend entirely on transcription speed and audio difficulty; there is no guaranteed volume of work.
catches: Piece rate only: paid per audio minute, never by the hour; effective hourly pay depends on transcription speed and audio difficulty.
Rate depends on experience, turnaround time, shift, and difficulty of audio — the range is not guaranteed.
Must be a U.S. resident; cannot hire or onboard people in California, New Jersey, or Massachusetts.
Must pass the initiation test (at least 95% correct) and consent to a criminal background check.
Job positions depend on availability; high inquiry volume means not every applicant is contacted.
No equipment purchase is required, but a computer (8GB+ RAM recommended) and 10+ Mbps internet are needed.

steps: Complete the online employment form at dittotranscripts.com (U.S. residents only)
Pass the initiation test with at least 95% correct (accuracy, speed, grammar, spelling, sample transcript)
Consent to a criminal background check and be contacted by their office
Take on transcription assignments across legal, law enforcement, academic, financial, or general business
Complete assignments to quality standards from home
Get paid on the 1st and 15th of every month via direct deposit or PayPal
